approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the ACME Bonsai Director of Sales team (Cash)

approve_quote_send.notes: Every quote drafted by a sub-agent requires Cash's review before send. Margin floor must be verified.

approve_discount_standard.notes: Discounts ≤ 20% off list: Cash approval. Documented rationale required.

approve_discount_volume.notes: Discounts 20-25% on wholesale orders > 100 trees: Cash volume-tier approval.

approve_discount_large.notes: Discounts > 25% or below cost: requires Cash + Jane + Margin (via Sterling) all three. Strategic rationale documented.

approve_subscription_short_term.notes: Subscription contract < 12 months requires Jane approval.

approve_custom_commercial_terms.notes: Any custom commercial terms (non-standard payment, custom SLA, custom clauses) require Jane approval.

approve_customer_refund.notes: Customer dispute refund > $1,000 requires Jane approval.

approve_major_account_save.notes: Concessions to retain a major account (wholesale > $10K/year or subscription > $1K/month) require Jane approval.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop can be activated immediately by Cash or Jane.
